summary: Plan a minimal closure pass for the desktop knowledge surface by turning the character, location, and plot tabs into explicit read-only selection/detail flows, removing dead create affordances from the active UX path, and expanding modal-level behavior tests without adding new product scope or backend mutation contracts.

tasks.title: Close non-skill knowledge tab dead ends inside KnowledgeModal
tasks.description: Implement the minimum user-facing closure for the 3 non-skill tabs by adding a real selection/detail path for existing items and converting the current empty-state add buttons into explicit unavailable states instead of dead CTAs. Keep the scope read-only and reuse the current modal shell rather than introducing new creation APIs.
tasks.scope: desktop knowledge modal only: characters, locations, and plots remain read-only, but every visible click target becomes meaningful and every empty-state entrypoint becomes intentionally non-actionable with clear UI feedback.

criteria: 1 shared non-skill selection state is added in `KnowledgeModal.tsx` for 3 tabs: characters, locations, and plots.
3 item-list flows expose deterministic read-only detail content when a user clicks a character, location, or plot card.
3 empty-state add CTAs are removed from the dead-action path by rendering an explicit unavailable state: disabled button, static message, or equivalent non-clickable affordance.
convergence.definition_of_done: A user can open the knowledge modal, switch to any of the 3 non-skill tabs, select an existing item to inspect it inside the modal, and no longer encounter a clickable create affordance that does nothing.

implementation.title: Add shared non-skill selection and detail state
implementation.description: Introduce modal state for the selected non-skill knowledge item and render a compact read-only detail surface using the data already loaded by each tab.

implementation.title: Wire card clicks for all 3 tabs
implementation.description: Connect `CharacterTab`, `LocationTab`, and `PlotTab` card clicks to the modal selection flow, keeping the skill-tab behavior unchanged.

implementation.title: Retire dead empty-state create affordances
implementation.description: Replace the current add buttons in the 3 empty states with intentionally disabled or non-clickable UI that communicates the read-only boundary until a future creation workflow exists.

tasks.title: Add behavior coverage for knowledge-surface closure
tasks.description: Expand the existing modal test file from accessibility and labels into behavior-focused coverage for the non-skill closure path: tab loading, item selection, detail rendering, and inactive create affordances.
tasks.scope: Keep coverage in the current `KnowledgeModal.test.tsx` surface and validate the closed behavior for character, location, and plot tabs without creating separate test suites unless the implementation forces a helper extraction.

criteria: 1 existing modal test file covers 3 non-skill tabs instead of label-only rendering.
3 click-to-detail behaviors are asserted: character, location, and plot selection each reveals stable read-only detail output.
3 empty-state affordances are asserted as intentionally inactive or explicitly unavailable, so regressions cannot reintroduce dead buttons.
convergence.definition_of_done: The knowledge modal has automated coverage for the exact closure behavior added in D1, and the test suite fails if future changes restore no-op clicks or dead empty-state actions on the non-skill tabs.

implementation.title: Extend mocks and fixtures for 3 non-skill datasets
implementation.description: Provide representative character, location, and plot payloads through the existing mocked graph and memory client APIs.

implementation.title: Assert item selection and detail rendering
implementation.description: Add user-event coverage that switches tabs, waits for data load, clicks a rendered item, and verifies the modal shows the expected read-only details.

implementation.title: Assert inactive empty-state create affordances
implementation.description: Cover the empty-state case for the 3 non-skill tabs and verify the UI now communicates unavailable creation rather than exposing a live no-op button.

risks: If stakeholders require real create flows instead of minimal closure, this module will need a follow-up dependency on the desktop API contract split because the scoped files do not currently define mutation contracts for characters, locations, or plots.

Character, location, and plot payloads are loosely typed `Record<string, unknown>` today, so the read-only detail surface may need a normalization rule to avoid inconsistent field rendering across graph and memory responses.
out_of_scope: Adding new gateway or Tauri mutation endpoints for creating characters, locations, or plots.
Changing Story Bible persistence, backup, or project-level storage behavior.
Broad product-positioning or copy rewrites outside the knowledge modal closure path.
